requirements.statement: It MUST provide robust and flexible authentication and authorization capabilities.

requirements.summary: Takes forms such as GUIs, ITSM, chat, portals or dashboards
requirements.statement: This component MAY take various forms depending on the needs of the end user, including graphical user interfaces, ITSM, change management systems, messaging platforms, documentation portals, or reporting dashboards.

requirements.summary: Supports both read and write interactions
requirements.statement: It MAY support both read and write interactions, enabling users to view data, initiate tasks, or approve changes.

claims.description: Polls multi-vendor network devices to track availability, traffic and hardware health, and shows the results in dashboards, maps and threshold-based alerts.
claims.claim_note: The product offers dashboards and reports for its own monitoring data, not a general interface for an automation system.

claims.description: Collects network telemetry such as flow, SNMP and streaming telemetry from data center, cloud and internet networks, stores it, and lets users query and visualize it.
claims.claim_note: The product provides views of its own telemetry data, not a general interface for an automation system.

claims.description: Network monitoring system that discovers devices with protocols such as SNMP, LLDP and CDP, collects their data, graphs it and sends alerts.
claims.claim_note: The product provides graphs, a web interface and an API for its own monitoring data.

claims.description: Monitoring software that collects metrics from network devices, servers and applications, detects problems against thresholds, sends notifications and shows the data in dashboards and maps.
claims.claim_note: The product provides dashboards and maps for its own monitoring data, not a general interface for an automation system.

claims.description: Monitoring software that runs plugin-based checks against servers, network devices, websites and services, and alerts on problems, with a basic web interface.
claims.claim_note: The product page describes only a basic web interface; configuration uses text files.

claims.description: On-premises Windows software that monitors devices, systems and traffic through sensors such as SNMP, and provides maps, dashboards, alerts and reports.
claims.claim_note: The product provides maps and dashboards for its own monitoring data, not a general interface for an automation system.

claims.description: NetBox models and documents network infrastructure, defines its intended state and makes that data available to automation tools through APIs and a web interface.
claims.claim_note: NetBox provides a user interface for its own data, but not dashboards or interfaces for the rest of an automation system.

claims.description: dcTrack is data center infrastructure management software that records physical assets, capacity and power and network connections, and manages change requests for data center equipment.
claims.claim_note: dcTrack provides 3D views and dashboards for its own data center data, not an interface for a whole network automation system.

claims.description: ServiceNow IT Service Management is a set of applications for handling IT incidents, problems, changes and service requests, with a service catalog, asset management and a CMDB.
claims.claim_note: The framework names ITSM as an example of a graphical user interface, but ITSM covers service processes rather than all interfaces to a network automation system.

claims.claim: Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) Backstage - Presentation
claims.description: Backstage is a framework for building developer portals around a catalog of software components, with project templates, documentation and plugins.
claims.claim_note: Backstage builds portals through which users interact with tools and services, but it is aimed at software development rather than network automation.

claims.description: Platform that runs and coordinates infrastructure-as-code workflows for Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Kubernetes and Ansible, with policies, approvals and drift detection.
claims.claim_note: Spacelift provides a web interface and assistant for its own workflows, not a general interface for the whole automation system.

claims.claim: The Apache Software Foundation Apache Airflow - Presentation
claims.product: The Apache Software Foundation Apache Airflow
claims.description: Platform for writing workflows as Python code and for scheduling and monitoring them.
claims.claim_note: The web application presents only the workflows and their runs, not the network state or intent.

claims.description: Platform for building and running scripts, workflows, internal apps and data pipelines, with schedules, webhooks and generated user interfaces.
claims.claim_note: The generated user interfaces and app builder give users a way to run automation, but Windmill provides no network-specific dashboards.
